'''Mr. Olafsen''' was an old [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[moisture farmer]] and the neighbor and friend of [[Ariq Joanson]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
